observations.rest_repeatability_practical_deg: within roughly 1–2 degrees in exploratory tracking

limitations: Arm tracking uses approximate frame-index timing; video has slightly variable timestamps.
Camera framing changed from running video; affine registration of stationary movement features is not a full optical calibration.
Rest marker center changes by several degrees with radial sampling and profile model.
Settled position is not independently proven to be the unloaded hairspring zero; escapement contact may influence final position.
conclusion: Useful repeatable settled reference, but no justified refinement of physical lift angle or firm attribution of acoustic tick/tock split.
